Managed Data Protection

An ongoing managed service that keeps your UU PDP program governed, your systems compliant as they change, and your evidence ready when customers, partners, or regulators ask.

Discuss This Service ↗What’s included ↓
Format
Ongoing managed service
Reporting
Monthly, with an annual program review
Best starting point
After an assessment or implementation, or with a baseline review during onboarding
Works with
Your DPO, management, IT, HR, and customer service teams

WHO IT IS FOR

Built for teams
like yours.

  • Medium enterprises that have completed an initial UU PDP program and need it maintained
  • Organizations introducing new systems, vendors, or features that use personal data
  • Companies without an in-house privacy team, or with a DPO who needs hands-on support

WHAT’S INCLUDED

What the service covers

The exact scope is confirmed in writing before work begins, based on your systems, priorities, and existing work.

01

Support for your appointed DPO

Day-to-day help for the data protection officer or accountable person you appoint, including preparation for management, customer, and regulator questions.

02

Records kept current

Your record of processing activities, data inventory, and vendor list are updated as systems, purposes, and suppliers change.

03

Data-subject request handling

Support to receive, verify, track, and answer requests for access, correction, deletion, and withdrawal of consent within the required timeframes.

04

Privacy review of changes

New systems, features, integrations, and vendors are reviewed for privacy impact before they go live, with impact assessments where the risk is high.

05

Incident and breach readiness

Breach procedures are kept current, your team is supported during incidents, and the response is rehearsed every year.

06

Controls monitoring

Agreed safeguards such as access reviews, retention rules, and logging are checked regularly to confirm they still operate.

UU PDP

Obligations this
service supports.

How this service helps you meet the requirements of Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection.

  • Records of processing activities
  • Data subject rights and response timeframes
  • Impact assessments for high-risk processing
  • Security of personal data
  • Breach notification readiness
  • Accountability and evidence of compliance

QUESTIONS

Common questions
about this service.

Something else on your mind? Ask our team ↗

Does PatuhData act as our DPO?

We support the data protection officer you appoint with day-to-day work and expertise. Appointing a DPO remains your organization’s decision. Where you need an external appointee, we can introduce qualified partners.

Do we need an assessment first?

It is recommended but not required. If you have no recent assessment, onboarding includes a baseline review so we know where your program stands.

How do you work with our team?

You get a named contact, a regular check-in, and a shared tracker for requests, reviews, and actions. We only access the systems and data the agreed scope requires.
